caveats: IRC inbound was broken in some pilot runs (agent bytes never reached the board); affected cells are excluded by default.
Board attribution is heuristic: reply and exposure edges are inferred from timing and read paths.
Agents in multi runs share a board; confidence intervals are bootstrapped by run, not by agent.
Models differ in tokenizer and reasoning style, and may have unequal numbers of runs per cell; compare them per interface, not by raw token counts.

In unsolvable-goal runs the flag can never be found: nobody solves, the whole budget is task time, and free-time metrics are n/a. Compare the goals on task-phase metrics (board contact, posts, board share over the run).
